caption: The drawing depicts a single old-fashioned doll with a painted face and black, wavy, molded hair. The doll’s face and hands are muted gray-green in color, with areas where the surface is chipped, revealing a different tone beneath. The doll wears a simple cream-colored dress adorned with thin tan stripes and a pattern of small, scattered motifs. The dress features a wide, flaring skirt and a lace trim at the hem and sleeves. Underneath, the doll has visible white bloomers with lace edges, and ribbed, light-olive stockings. On its feet are black lace-up boots. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light background, and below the doll is the handwritten name “CHARLOTTE ANGUS.”
title: Rag Doll
